title: Thermodynamics, Phase Transitions, and Geodesic Structure of F(R)-Phantom Banados-Teitelboim-Zanelli (BTZ) Black Holes
summary: This paper investigates phantom BTZ black holes within the high-curvature gravity theory framework, specifically using a special case of power-Maxwell theory, which functions as a nonlinear electrodynamics source called F(R)-conformally invariant Maxwell gravity. We examine how the phantom or anti-Maxwell field affects the structure of these black holes and how the theory's parameters influence their horizon structure.
